resources.string: DUB mode turns Now Playing into a dub mixer: an echo locked to the beat, a sweep filter, a five-way preamp with kills, and pads to throw, cut, drop, freeze and run the echo away. Turning it on turns DJ mode off; loops and cues stay. The effects are off while bit-perfect output is on and while playing on another device. THROW starts from what you heard when you touched it; the other controls are heard about 0.2 s after the touch. You can also turn it on from the … menu in Now Playing.
The reset puts the echo time, feedback, return, the filter lock and every preamp corner and level back to their defaults.
